subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader agent-runtime fix be the canonical landing branch instead of the narrower Tavily-only https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110?
rationale: Both branches contain valid overlapping Tavily work, but only this PR also repairs the Tool Search runtime-snapshot invariant; choosing the canonical branch affects landing history, attribution, and whether the broader ownership change is accepted.

options.title: Land the broader fix
options.body: Refresh this PR on current main, require exact-head credential and agent-tool gates, land it, and close or retarget the narrower overlapping PR.

options.title: Land the narrow Tavily fix
options.body: Use the narrower PR for the provider-local resolver and move the agent Tool Search snapshot repair into a separately owned follow-up.

options.title: Split before landing
options.body: Extract the shared agent runtime selector into one focused change and retain the Tavily resolver as a second coordinated change.

recommendation.title: Land the broader fix
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR on current main, require exact-head credential and agent-tool gates, land it, and close or retarget the narrower overlapping PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, who force-pushed and authored the current squashed revision and is therefore best positioned to select the canonical landing path.
